text: jonntran APP — 9/3/26, 7:45 AM Thursday, September 3, 2026 at 7:45 AM Observations: Overnight inventory for ES and NQ is balanced, with both markets able to pierce PDH. We have several medium-impact data releases before the open and ISM Services PMI at the start of the B period, with Fed Hammack Speech during power hour. Focus and Scenarios: The initial focus is an Open Within Range/Value and the potential for two-way trade. Moreover, ES has built acceptance back within the multi-day value, while NQ developed a two-day balance. Primary Scenario: Open Within Range/Value An opening within the previous session's range/value favors initial two-way trade until acceptance develops outside the balance. ES: Multi-day Value: 7673/76 (pdVAL/VAL) -> 7680/90/91 (POC/pwPOC/poor high) -> 7701/05/08 (gap fill/VAH/poor) Upside stretch targets: 7722/23 (VPOC/Sunday Open) Downside targets: 7661 (pwVAL) -> 7655 (pwLow) -> 7643 (PDL) NQ: Two-day Value: 29,092 (VAL), 29,150 (POC), 29,200/212/220 (VAH/poor high/pwPOC), 29,317 (two-day high) Upside target: 29,419 (VPOC) Upside stretch targets: 29,520 (gap fill), 29,540 (pwVAH/Sunday Open) Downside targets: 29,003 (two-day low) -> 28,956/946 (pwVAL/pwLow) Flow expectations: Within value, expect primarily responsive-type activity at the extremes until acceptance outside balance introduces the potential for initiative flow. Balanced OVN inventory → open within value → expect responsive activity within balance → watch extremes → rejection = rotation → acceptance outside = potential initiative participation → MGI becomes destination. In terms of profile, both ES and NQ closed the session with a P-shaped profile, which I typically interpret as short covering—old business being closed rather than new buyers initiating positions. This puts some emphasis on whether new initiative buyers emerge above value. And the usual intraday targets in terms of IB breaks and Sigma tags +/- 0.25σ and +/- 0.50σ.

text: jonntran APP — 7:08 AM Friday, September 11, 2026 at 7:08 AM Observations: Overnight inventory for ES and NQ is net long, with both markets trading above PDH and having the potential to open with a gap if prices maintain that location following CPI. We have Core CPI and CPI before the open, and Michigan Consumer Sentiment at the start of B period. Focus and Scenarios: The initial focus is the net long inventory and the potential gap opening. Primary Scenario: Gap Rules Go with the gap if buyers maintain acceptance above PDH. If price begins correcting net-long inventory, monitor PDH for acceptance or rejection, with a loss of PDH introducing gap-fill potential. Moreover, after the recent multi-day move lower, several unfilled gaps remain above, making it important to map their locations as potential auction destinations. We have Core CPI and CPI before the open, and Michigan Consumer Sentiment at the start of B period. Focus and Scenarios: The initial focus is the net long inventory and the potential gap opening. Primary Scenario: Gap Rules Go with the gap if buyers maintain acceptance above PDH. If price begins correcting net-long inventory, monitor PDH for acceptance or rejection, with a loss of PDH introducing gap-fill potential. Moreover, after the recent multi-day move lower, several unfilled gaps remain above, making it important to map their locations as potential auction destinations. ES: Primary Focus: 7594/7600 (VAL/POC), 7609 (VAH), 7618/20 (pwLow/PDH) Upside targets: 7635 (static level for the week) -> 7644 (VPOC/pwVAL) -> 7648 (gap fill) -> 7678/79 (gap fill/pwPOC) Downside targets: 7585 (PDL/poor) -> 7542-7521/03 (gap fill range) NQ: Primary Focus: 29,110, 29,143/154 (gap fill/POC/pwVAL), 29,220, 29,275 (PDH) Upside targets: 29,358 -> 29,450/460 (VPOC/gap fill) -> 29,520/535 (pwPOC/Sunday Open) -> 29,600/608 (pwVAH/VPOC) Upside stretch targets: 29,686/692/704 (PDH/weak level/pwHigh) Downside targets: 29,058 (PDL) -> 28,927/915 (pwLow/VPOC) Flow expectations: Net-long OVN → open above PDH → initiative buying expected → responsive selling/inventory correction → correction fails → renewed initiative buying/acceptance higher → MGI. author: jonntran
parse_text: Observations: Overnight inventory for ES and NQ is net short, as volume has traded mostly below PDL. ES is farther below PDL by about 10 points, while NQ is trading around PDL. We have the Dallas Fed Manufacturing Index at the start of B period. Focus and Scenarios: Net short inventory with the potential for a gap opening if prices cannot reclaim PDL and the last price. Both ES and NQ printed two-day overlapping value, so the two-day value will be the primary AOIs, along with recent MGI. With that said, they both have a multi-day value structure that could be the destination, using the context of the gap rules to assist. Primary Scenario: Gap Rules Go with the gap if sellers maintain acceptance below PDL. A reclaim of PDL and gap fill introduces the potential to traverse the two-day value. ES: Two-day value: 7715/22/25/27 (VAL/POC/gap fill/pwVAH), 7745 (VAH), 7755 (PDH) Multi-day Value: 7705 (VAH) -> 7690 (pwPOC) -> 7676 (VAL) Upside stretch target: 7782 (PDH/pwHigh) Downside stretch target: 7661 (pwVAL) NQ: Two-day value: 29,484 (VAL), 29,509 (gap fill), 29,540 (pwVAH/Sunday Open), 29,575 (POC), 29,650 (VAH) Multi-day value: 29,408 (VAH) -> 29,284 (POC) -> 29,210/220 (VAL/pwPOC) Upside stretch targets: 29,700 (HVE) -> 29,811 (PDH/pwHigh) Downside stretch targets: 28,956/946 (pwVAL/pwLow) Flow expectations: Initiative selling below PDL → responsive buying/short covering tests the move → acceptance below PDL favors renewed initiative selling → failure to maintain acceptance favors inventory correction/gap fill. Net-short OVN inventory → open below PDL → monitor inventory correction/responsive buying → acceptance below PDL = initiative selling/continuation → reclaim PDL = correction/gap fill → MGI becomes destination. And the usual intraday targets in terms of IB breaks and Sigma tags +/- 0.25σ and +/- 0.50σ.
